    Karol G is set to close out Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 on Sunday, April 19, 2026, as the festival's first-ever Latina headliner. Performing on the main Coachella Stage, her set is scheduled for 10:10 p.m. PDT. The show follows her highly acclaimed Weekend 1 performance and is available on the official Coachella YouTube channel. 
    • Performance Details: Karol G takes the main stage at 10:10 p.m. PDT on Sunday, April 19, 2026, anchoring the final night of the festival.
    • Significance: She is making history as the first Latina headliner, turning the performance into a major celebration of culture.
    • Weekend 2 Coverage: Similar to Weekend 1, her set is featured on the Coachella YouTube livestream.
    • Weekend 1 Highlights: Her previous weekend featured high-energy performances, including her "LATINA FOREVA" theme. 
    Karol G is part of the final Sunday lineup alongside other major acts like BigBang and Kid Cudi.

    @karolg’s Weekend 1 performance at @coachella was praised for many reasons, but among the standouts was when she brought out the all-female mariachi band, Mariachi Reyna de Los Ángeles, to join her on stage. Since then, controversy has erupted after people uncovered the owner’s conservative politics, with many people calling for the singer to switch mariachis for her Weekend 2 performance. With Karol G coming out in public support of immigrants at Coachella, and Becky G even shouting them out, the question arises of whether the musicians, who are employees, should be penalized by missing out on the opportunity of a lifetime because of their boss’s politics.
